exact.点最多两下，且不能相邻。: At most two jabs, and they cannot touch.
exact.闪吃劈，架吃劈，点吃停，虚吃闪。: Slip answers a chop. Guard answers a chop. Jab answers a pause. A feint punishes a slip.
exact.短语还是四下歇: The phrase is still four rests
exact.点不能相邻，也不能超过两下，而且要留一个歇。: Jabs cannot touch or exceed two, and one beat must rest.
exact.闪吃劈，架也吃劈。点吃停。虚专吃闪。没有一拍能回答全部来势。: Slip answers a chop, and so does guard. Jab answers a pause. A feint punishes a slip. No single beat answers every intent.
exact.把本局短语最后的四拍、受击和拆招写进你自己的 memory。来势每轮会换。只把这: Write the last four beats, the damage you took, and the ripostes into your own memory. The incoming bar changes every round. Treat that as an observation of this seed and check it again on the next seed.
